brief: Owner direction: less AI, more graphically focused, lots of info but clear; timeline more central; fix info-overload runs (the four Supreme Court case cards named); maps, images, interactive things; play with 3D, push limits, go outside normal 2D.

process.council: Full LLM council: 5 advisors (Contrarian, First Principles, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor), anonymized peer review by 5 reviewers, chairman synthesis.
keyRulings: Archival image pass and record-table conversion were unanimous sure wins; parallax photo mounts unanimously killed.
The Contrarian's honesty objection (ordinal grade extruded as continuous height fabricates a magnitude) was resolved with discrete stepped tiers explicitly labeled as rank, not measurement.
The geological strata timeline was killed for the scroll inversion two advisors caught independently and for naturalizing an engineered process.
Four-doors became one-current-rerouting after First Principles showed the cases are one mechanism rerouting, not four separate doors.
The persistent terrain-spine and time-scrub visions were cut; the terrain is one station's centerpiece, and any real-magnitude extrusion waits for a cited per-area dataset.

gate1.artifact: Static stepped-tier render of all 703 real citywide polygons, one real sheet (D-30, filed March 1940) with the period-language note, composed as a phone-width mock.
gate1.killQuestion: Does this read as museum evidence or a tech demo?
results: Blind skeptic: 'serious museum evidence'; the rank-not-measurement disclosure and the primary document earned it; asked for a facsimile path to the original scan.
Blind museum curator: 'Yes, I'd floor this'; required the content framing before the document and naming the actor (HOLC's surveyors); both shipped.
Blind fresh visitor: understood the encoding in 15 seconds from the page alone, wanted to interact, would share it.

implementation.relief: SVG 2.5D over WebGL, deliberately: all 703 areas stay real DOM buttons behind one roving tab stop, the suite sees everything, no context-loss or gesture-conflict class of failure. Turn is a 7-stop native range input; measured recompute 81ms per stop. Relief is ch0's resting view; ch6 rests on the flat study map; the flat map is one tap away in both.
implementation.casesFlow: One red current down two lanes, public law and private paper; ink barriers at 1917 and 1948; nodes at 1926 and 1940; the current exits toward sales on contract. Four junction hit targets keep the case- testids; one detail card with holding, consequence, registered fact, and the opinion link.
implementation.recordTimeline: Vertical spine, all 11 entries oldest to newest, machinery-era years (1921 to 1968) in red, same registered FactValues.
implementation.figures: ch1 1851 Rees plat (LOC); ch8 University Apartments (CC BY-SA) and 63rd Street Woodlawn July 1973 with its National Archives caption quoted; ch10 22nd and South State newsstand July 1973 (NARA DOCUMERICA, captions verified against the archival records).
implementation.retention: Reading time in the opening line, chapter position added to the mobile era chip, find-the-ground link at the top of the exhibit jumping to the locate control.

liveCheck.note: A blind skeptical pass over the live dev-mode station returned 'impressive but showing off' with four complaints; all four traced to dev-mode or element-screenshot artifacts (Next.js dev button, fixed bottom rail crossing an element screenshot, the test script's own area selection landing on Lake Bluff, popover invisible in a still). The static-mock test on the identical design had passed 3 of 3. No design change was made; recorded here for honesty.

suite: 151 checks across 15 scenarios, all green; production build clean.
